[[Kuudra]] Infernal Tier Completion |id = TORMENTOR }} A '''Tormentor''' is a {{Legendary}} [[Swords|Sword]] that can be obtained from paid reward chests after defeating [[Kuudra]]. == Obtaining == A '''Tormentor''' has a {{Chance|0.1%|1|972}} chance to appear in the [[Kuudra#Loot|Infernal Kuudra]] paid chest. == Usage == {{ItemInfo |type = Sword |name = Tormentor |rarity = l |damage = 525 |crit_damage = 100 |strength = 30 |item_ability_name = Angered |item_ability_description = You take {{Red|+50%}} damage while holding this weapon. |item_ability_name2 = Chain of Agony |item_ability_activation2 = Right Click |item_ability_mana_cost2 = 200 |item_ability_cooldown2 = 0.5s |item_ability_description2 = {{DarkGray|Toggles On/Off on use}}
